## Save the corridor design

```{r save-corridors}
saveRDS(
  list(
    nodes                 = node_info,
    demand_matrix         = W,
    candidates            = candidates,
    selected_corridors    = selected_corridors,
    service_time_matrix   = state$service,
    quality_matrix        = state$quality,
    penalty_per_pair      = state$per_pair,
    penalty_total         = state$penalty_total,
    n_over_threshold      = state$n_over,
    n_unreachable         = state$n_unreach,
    max_detour_ratio      = params$max_detour_ratio,
    max_corridor_nodes    = params$max_corridor_nodes,
    safety_cap            = params$n_bus_corridors,
    transfer_penalty_min  = params$transfer_penalty_min,
    quality_threshold_pct = params$quality_threshold_pct,
    unreachable_quality   = params$unreachable_quality
  ),
  file.path(params$out_dir, "corridor_design.rds")
)

fwrite(selected_df,
       file.path(params$out_dir, "corridor_design_selected.csv"))

# Top pairs by *remaining penalty* (worst-served high-demand pairs).
# This is the "limitations" paragraph in the thesis — pairs the design
# can't quite reach to threshold, ranked by demand-weighted excess.
worst_pairs_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(state$per_pair)) %>%
  rename(node_a = Var1, node_b = Var2, penalty = Freq) %>%
  filter(as.integer(as.character(node_a)) < as.integer(as.character(node_b)),
         penalty > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(penalty)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  mutate(
    # Translate cell_id (e.g., 386) → row/column position (1..n_nodes)
    pa = match(as.character(node_a), as.character(node_info$cell_id)),
    pb = match(as.character(node_b), as.character(node_info$cell_id)),
    quality = state$quality[cbind(pa, pb)],
    demand  = W[cbind(pa, pb)]
  ) %>%
  select(-pa, -pb)
worst_pairs_df
```

## Export: GTFS feed + shapefile for ArcGIS

GTFS contains only the **bus corridors** (the rail lines stay in their
source feeds at `40_gtfs.zip` / `96_gtfs.zip` — load them alongside this
one). Shapefile contains *all* selected corridors (bus + rail) plus the
node points.

Schedule conventions match your other generated feeds:

- 30 s dwell at every stop
- 2.5 min headway during the day (06:00 – 22:00)
- 5 min headway at night (22:00 – 01:00 next day)
- Mon–Fri service

```{r export-params}
gtfs_dir   <- file.path(params$out_dir, "gtfs_node_bus")
gtfs_zip   <- file.path(params$gtfs_out_dir, "gtfs_node_bus.zip")
shp_routes <- file.path(params$out_dir, "corridors_routes.shp")
shp_stops  <- file.path(params$out_dir, "corridors_stops.shp")

dir.create(gtfs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dwell_sec          <- as.integer(params$express_dwell_sec)
day_start          <- "05:00:00"
day_end            <- "22:00:00"
day_headway_sec    <- 120L      # 2 min
night_start        <- "22:00:00"
night_end          <- "29:00:00"  # 1 AM next service day (GTFS allows >24h)
night_headway_sec  <- 360L      # 6 min

service_start_date <- "20260101"
service_end_date   <- "20261231"

sec_to_gtfs <- function(s) {
  s <- as.integer(round(s))
  sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", s %/% 3600L, (s %% 3600L) %/% 60L, s %% 60L)
}
```

### Build GTFS tables

```{r build-gtfs-tables}
bus_corridors <- Filter(function(c) c$type == "bus", selected_corridors)
n_bus <- length(bus_corridors)
cat(sprintf("Generating GTFS for %d bus corridors\n", n_bus))

# agency.txt
agency_df <- data.frame(
  agency_id       = "NodeNet",
  agency_name     = "Node-Based Network",
  agency_url      = "https://example.org/node-net",
  agency_timezone = "America/Los_Angeles",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# calendar.txt — weekday service
calendar_df <- data.frame(
  service_id = "WEEKDAY",
  monday     = 1L, tuesday = 1L, wednesday = 1L, thursday = 1L, friday = 1L,
  saturday   = 0L, sunday  = 0L,
  start_date = service_start_date,
  end_date   = service_end_date,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# stops.txt — p-median nodes + transfer points
stop_id_for_full_idx <- function(idx) {
  if (idx <= n_nodes) {
    sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id[idx])
  } else {
    sprintf("TP%03d", idx - n_nodes)
  }
}

stops_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    stop_id   = sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id),
    stop_name = sprintf("Node cell %d", node_info$cell_id),
    stop_lat  = round(node_info$lat, 7),
    stop_lon  = round(node_info$lon, 7),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  if (n_transfer > 0L)
    data.frame(
      stop_id   = sprintf("TP%03d", seq_len(n_transfer)),
      stop_name = sprintf("Transfer: %s", transfer_info$name),
      stop_lat  = round(transfer_info$lat, 7),
      stop_lon  = round(transfer_info$lon, 7),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  else
    data.frame(stop_id = character(0), stop_name = character(0),
               stop_lat = numeric(0), stop_lon = numeric(0),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

# routes.txt — one per bus corridor
make_route_id <- function(i) sprintf("BUS%03d", i)

routes_df <- data.frame(
  route_id         = vapply(seq_len(n_bus), make_route_id, character(1)),
  agency_id        = "NodeNet",
  route_short_name = vapply(bus_corridors, `[[`, character(1), "label"),
  route_long_name  = vapply(bus_corridors, function(c) {
    paste(node_info$cell_id[c$sequence], collapse = " ↔ ")
  }, character(1)),
  route_type       = 3L,           # 3 = bus
  route_color      = "0066AA",
  route_text_color = "FFFFFF",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Build trip/stop_times/shape/frequency tables, per corridor × direction
shape_coords_for_bus <- function(seq_v) {
  chunks <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(length(seq_v) - 1)) {
    vids <- all_paths[[seq_v[k]]][[seq_v[k + 1]]]
    cc <- path_to_coords(vids)
    if (is.null(cc)) next
    if (k > 1 && nrow(cc) >= 2) cc <- cc[-1, , drop = FALSE]
    chunks[[length(chunks) + 1]] <- cc
  }
  if (length(chunks) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, chunks)
}

trips_list      <- list()
stop_times_list <- list()
shapes_list     <- list()
freq_list       <- list()

# ---- shared street-derived stop-time model (same as grid + local; freeway-safe via OSM fallback) ----
# dodgr still FINDS the corridor paths above; here we re-TIME them with the shared model so the
# express output matches every other network. (Enumeration/scoring still use dodgr T_full_min.)
source("BusStopTimeModel.R")
gst_p <- gst_default_params(list(
  crs_work = params$planar_crs, stop_route_buffer_ft = 700,
  signals_gpkg = "data/public/sdot/traffic_signals.gpkg",
  alllanes_geojson = "outputs/streets/street_grid.geojson"))
gst_routes <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_bus), function(i) {
  co <- shape_coords_for_bus(bus_corridors[[i]]$sequence)
  if (is.null(co) || nrow(co) < 2) return(NULL)
  sf::st_sf(rid = make_route_id(i), geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_linestring(co[, 1:2]), crs = 4326))
}))
gst_stops   <- sf::st_as_sf(stops_df, coords = c("stop_lon", "stop_lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
gst_refs    <- gst_load_refs(gst_p)
gst_prepped <- gst_prep(gst_routes, gst_refs, gst_p)
gst_stops   <- gst_classify_stops(gst_stops, gst_prepped, gst_refs, gst_p)
cat(sprintf("Express timing via shared model: %d corridors, %d stops, %.0f%% signalized\n",
            nrow(gst_routes), nrow(gst_stops), 100 * mean(gst_stops$signalized)))

for (i in seq_len(n_bus)) {
  c        <- bus_corridors[[i]]
  route_id <- make_route_id(i)
  seq_v    <- c$sequence
  shape_id <- sprintf("SBUS%03d", i)

  # Shape geometry (same for both directions — GTFS doesn't require reversed shapes)
  shape_coords <- shape_coords_for_bus(seq_v)
  if (is.null(shape_coords)) {
    warning("No shape coords for ", route_id, " — skipping")
    next
  }
  shapes_list[[length(shapes_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    shape_id          = shape_id,
    shape_pt_lat      = round(shape_coords[, 2], 7),
    shape_pt_lon      = round(shape_coords[, 1], 7),
    shape_pt_sequence = seq_len(nrow(shape_coords)),
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )

  # full_seq includes p-median nodes AND any transfer points within buffer
  full_seq_fwd <- c$full_seq
  if (is.null(full_seq_fwd) || length(full_seq_fwd) < 2L) {
    warning("Corridor ", route_id, " has no full_seq — falling back to sequence")
    full_seq_fwd <- c$sequence
  }

  # stop_times from the SHARED model on the dodgr-found path (free-flow speeds incl. OSM freeway
  # fallback, signal/gap-acceptance dwell, accel/decel). Falls back to the dodgr T_full_min matrix
  # + flat dwell only if a corridor can't be timed by the model.
  cand_ids <- unique(vapply(full_seq_fwd, stop_id_for_full_idx, character(1)))
  res <- if (route_id %in% gst_routes$rid)
    gst_route_stop_times(route_id, gst_routes[gst_routes$rid == route_id, ],
                         gst_stops[gst_stops$stop_id %in% cand_ids, ], gst_prepped, gst_p) else NULL
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    stop_times_list[[length(stop_times_list) + 1]] <- res$st0
    stop_times_list[[length(stop_times_list) + 1]] <- res$st1
  }

  for (dir in 0:1) {
    full_seq_dir <- if (dir == 0L) full_seq_fwd else rev(full_seq_fwd)
    trip_id <- sprintf("%s_d%d", route_id, dir)

    trips_list[[length(trips_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      route_id     = route_id,
      service_id   = "WEEKDAY",
      trip_id      = trip_id,
      shape_id     = shape_id,
      direction_id = as.integer(dir),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (is.null(res)) {   # fallback: dodgr T_full_min between consecutive stops + flat dwell
      arr <- 0L; dep <- arr + dwell_sec
      rows <- list()
      rows[[1]] <- data.frame(
        trip_id = trip_id, arrival_time = sec_to_gtfs(arr), departure_time = sec_to_gtfs(dep),
        stop_id = stop_id_for_full_idx(full_seq_dir[1]), stop_sequence = 1L, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      for (k in 2:length(full_seq_dir)) {
        travel_sec <- round(T_full_min[full_seq_dir[k - 1], full_seq_dir[k]] * 60)
        arr <- dep + travel_sec; dep <- arr + dwell_sec
        rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
          trip_id = trip_id, arrival_time = sec_to_gtfs(arr), departure_time = sec_to_gtfs(dep),
          stop_id = stop_id_for_full_idx(full_seq_dir[k]), stop_sequence = as.integer(k), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
      stop_times_list[[length(stop_times_list) + 1]] <- bind_rows(rows)
    }

    # Frequencies — day band + night band
    freq_list[[length(freq_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      trip_id      = trip_id,
      start_time   = c(day_start, night_start),
      end_time     = c(day_end,   night_end),
      headway_secs = c(day_headway_sec, night_headway_sec),
      exact_times  = 0L,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

trips_df      <- bind_rows(trips_list)
stop_times_df <- bind_rows(stop_times_list)
shapes_df     <- bind_rows(shapes_list)
freq_df       <- bind_rows(freq_list)

data.frame(
  table = c("agency", "routes", "stops", "trips", "stop_times",
            "shapes", "calendar", "frequencies"),
  rows  = c(nrow(agency_df), nrow(routes_df), nrow(stops_df),
            nrow(trips_df), nrow(stop_times_df), nrow(shapes_df),
            nrow(calendar_df), nrow(freq_df))
)
```

         finally = setwd(old_wd))

# Part 3 — Local feeder routes

### Goal

Design local feeder routes that bring ~1200 stops to the 12 express nodes.

- **Frequent stops** (`frequent_stops.shp`) — **must** be served.
- **Local stops** (`local_stops.shp`) — served best-effort.

A stop is *served* if it's within `walk_dist_ft` of a route whose path passes
through a node. Routes run on arterials (residential penalized) and pass
**through** nodes (serving stops on both sides), not terminating at them.

### Load stops

```{r load-stops}
read_stops <- function(path, kind) {
  s <- sf::st_read(path, quiet = TRUE) %>% sf::st_transform(params$planar_crs)
  s$kind <- kind
  s$stop_uid <- sprintf("%s_%04d", substr(kind, 1, 1), seq_len(nrow(s)))
  s[, c("stop_uid", "kind")]
}

freq_sf  <- read_stops(params$frequent_stops_shp, "frequent")
local_sf <- read_stops(params$local_stops_shp,    "local")

stops_sf <- rbind(freq_sf, local_sf)
stops_4326 <- sf::st_transform(stops_sf, 4326)
stops_xy   <- sf::st_coordinates(stops_4326)
colnames(stops_xy) <- c("x", "y")

n_stops <- nrow(stops_sf)
cat(sprintf("Loaded %d stops: %d frequent (mandatory), %d local (optional)\n",
            n_stops, sum(stops_sf$kind == "frequent"), sum(stops_sf$kind == "local")))
```

### Load nodes

```{r load-nodes}
cd <- readRDS(params$corridor_design_rds)
node_info <- cd$nodes          # cell_id, vertex_id, lon, lat, ...
n_nodes   <- nrow(node_info)
cat(sprintf("Loaded %d express nodes\n", n_nodes))
node_info[, c("cell_id", "lon", "lat")]
```

### Arterial-preferring graph

Penalize residential / service / living_street so routing prefers arterials but
can still reach an isolated frequent stop when there's no arterial nearby.

```{r local-build-graph}
graph <- readRDS(params$graph_rds)

# Clip to Seattle + buffer. The cached graph covers the whole PSRC 4-county
# area (millions of edges); local routing only needs Seattle, and a per-source
# Dijkstra over the full graph is what made the spoke step crawl (~16s each).
all_lon <- c(stops_xy[, "x"], node_info$lon)
all_lat <- c(stops_xy[, "y"], node_info$lat)
buf <- 0.03   # ~2 mi in degrees
keep_edge <-
  graph$from_lon >= min(all_lon) - buf & graph$from_lon <= max(all_lon) + buf &
  graph$from_lat >= min(all_lat) - buf & graph$from_lat <= max(all_lat) + buf &
  graph$to_lon   >= min(all_lon) - buf & graph$to_lon   <= max(all_lon) + buf &
  graph$to_lat   >= min(all_lat) - buf & graph$to_lat   <= max(all_lat) + buf
cat(sprintf("Clipping graph to Seattle bbox: %d → %d edges\n",
            nrow(graph), sum(keep_edge)))
graph <- graph[keep_edge, , drop = FALSE]

# Drop `service` highways (alleys, parking-lot access, driveways) entirely —
# same convention as GenerateNodeGTFS / Phase2RunSimulation: service
# edges add routing noise, rarely serve through-traffic, and have caused perf
# and correctness problems on this project before.
if ("highway" %in% colnames(graph)) {
  n_before <- nrow(graph)
  graph    <- graph[as.character(graph$highway) != "service", , drop = FALSE]
  cat(sprintf("Dropped service edges: %d → %d (%d removed)\n",
              n_before, nrow(graph), n_before - nrow(graph)))
} else {
  warning("Graph has no `highway` column — service filter skipped.")
}

# Largest connected component (recompute AFTER dropping service — removal can
# orphan pieces that were only reachable through an alley/driveway).
graph <- dodgr::dodgr_components(graph)
graph <- graph[graph$component == 1L, , drop = FALSE]

# Penalize remaining non-arterial classes (kept, unlike service: a feeder may
# need a residential street to reach an isolated frequent stop when no arterial
# is nearby). dodgr_times uses time_weighted; dodgr_paths uses d_weighted —
# penalize both so paths AND times prefer arterials.
penalize <- c("residential", "living_street", "unclassified")
is_pen <- as.character(graph$highway) %in% penalize
cat(sprintf("Penalizing %d / %d edges (residential/living_street/unclassified) ×%g\n",
            sum(is_pen), nrow(graph), params$residential_penalty))
graph$d_weighted[is_pen]    <- graph$d_weighted[is_pen]    * params$residential_penalty
graph$time_weighted[is_pen] <- graph$time_weighted[is_pen] * params$residential_penalty

graph_v     <- dodgr::dodgr_vertices(graph)
v_idx_by_id <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(graph_v)), graph_v$id)

path_to_coords <- function(vertex_ids) {
  if (is.null(vertex_ids) || length(vertex_ids) < 2) return(NULL)
  idx <- v_idx_by_id[as.character(vertex_ids)]
  idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
  if (length(idx) < 2) return(NULL)
  cbind(graph_v$x[idx], graph_v$y[idx])
}
```

### Snap nodes and stops to the graph

```{r snap}
node_lonlat <- as.data.frame(node_info[, c("lon", "lat")])
colnames(node_lonlat) <- c("x", "y")
node_vert <- graph_v$id[dodgr::match_pts_to_verts(graph_v, node_lonlat, connected = TRUE)]

stop_vert <- graph_v$id[dodgr::match_pts_to_verts(graph_v, as.data.frame(stops_xy),
                                                  connected = TRUE)]

cat(sprintf("Snapped %d nodes and %d stops to graph vertices\n", n_nodes, n_stops))
```

### Stop → node assignment

```{r assign}
# Travel time (penalized minutes) from every node to every stop
T_node_stop <- dodgr::dodgr_times(graph, from = node_vert, to = stop_vert) / 60
# rows = nodes, cols = stops

# For each stop, nearest node + any within dual_assign_ratio × nearest
assign_list <- vector("list", n_stops)
for (s in seq_len(n_stops)) {
  ts <- T_node_stop[, s]
  if (all(!is.finite(ts))) { assign_list[[s]] <- integer(0); next }
  best <- min(ts, na.rm = TRUE)
  assign_list[[s]] <- which(is.finite(ts) & ts <= params$dual_assign_ratio * best)
}

n_unreach <- sum(lengths(assign_list) == 0L)
cat(sprintf("Stops with ≥1 reachable node: %d / %d  (unreachable: %d)\n",
            n_stops - n_unreach, n_stops, n_unreach))
cat(sprintf("Stops assigned to 2+ nodes (between-node): %d\n",
            sum(lengths(assign_list) >= 2L)))
```

### Spoke generation (per node)

For each node, greedily cover its assigned stops with radial arterial paths:
route node → farthest uncovered assigned stop, mark everything within walkshed
of that path covered, repeat. Each path is a spoke with a bearing.

```{r spokes}
walk_ft <- params$walk_dist_ft

# Helper: which stops are within walk_dist of a path. st_distance on the
# projected CRS (EPSG:2926, US feet) returns feet, so compare to walk_ft.
stops_planar_geom <- sf::st_geometry(stops_sf)
covered_by_path <- function(coords_lonlat) {
  if (is.null(coords_lonlat) || nrow(coords_lonlat) < 2) return(integer(0))
  line <- sf::st_linestring(coords_lonlat) |>
    sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326) |> sf::st_transform(params$planar_crs)
  d <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(stops_planar_geom, line))
  which(d <= walk_ft)
}

bearing_deg <- function(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2)
  (atan2(lon2 - lon1, lat2 - lat1) * 180 / pi) %% 360

spokes <- list()   # each: node_idx, endpoint, bearing, vseq, coords, covered

cat(sprintf("Spoke generation over %d nodes:\n", n_nodes))
t_all <- Sys.time()

for (ni in seq_len(n_nodes)) {
  mine <- which(vapply(assign_list, function(a) ni %in% a, logical(1)))
  if (length(mine) == 0L) {
    cat(sprintf("  [%2d/%d] cell %d: 0 stops\n", ni, n_nodes, node_info$cell_id[ni]))
    next
  }

  t_node <- Sys.time()
  # ONE batched dodgr_paths call: this node → all its assigned stops (one
  # Dijkstra, extract all paths). Was previously one call PER spoke — that's
  # what made this hang. dodgr returns the inner list in the SAME ORDER as
  # `to` (1:1, duplicates preserved, NOT deduped) and names it "from-to", so
  # index it positionally by where `far` sits within `mine` — never by vertex id.
  node_paths <- dodgr::dodgr_paths(graph, from = node_vert[ni],
                                   to = stop_vert[mine], vertices = TRUE)[[1]]

  covered <- logical(n_stops)
  n_sp <- 0L
  repeat {
    remaining <- mine[!covered[mine]]
    if (length(remaining) == 0L) break
    far  <- remaining[which.max(T_node_stop[ni, remaining])]
    vseq <- node_paths[[ match(far, mine) ]]
    if (is.null(vseq) || length(vseq) < 2L) { covered[far] <- TRUE; next }
    coords   <- path_to_coords(vseq)
    cov      <- covered_by_path(coords)
    cov_mine <- intersect(cov, mine)
    if (length(cov_mine) == 0L) cov_mine <- far   # ensure progress
    covered[cov_mine] <- TRUE
    n_sp <- n_sp + 1L
    spokes[[length(spokes) + 1]] <- list(
      node_idx = ni, endpoint = far,
      bearing  = bearing_deg(node_info$lon[ni], node_info$lat[ni],
                             stops_xy[far, "x"], stops_xy[far, "y"]),
      vseq = vseq, coords = coords, covered = cov
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("  [%2d/%d] cell %d: %d stops → %d spokes (%.1fs)\n",
              ni, n_nodes, node_info$cell_id[ni], length(mine), n_sp,
              as.numeric(Sys.time() - t_node, units = "secs")))
}

cat(sprintf("Total: %d spokes in %.1f s\n",
            length(spokes), as.numeric(Sys.time() - t_all, units = "secs")))
```

### Candidate routes (spokes, through-routes, multi-node through-lines)

Three kinds of candidate, all built from the per-node spokes:

- **spoke** — an unpaired radial (only where nothing pairs with it).
- **through** — two opposite spokes at one node, joined (serves both sides of a node).
- **line** — a *multi-node through-line*: a neighborhood tail, in through node A,
  along the A→B arterial path (passing any nodes on the way), out to a neighborhood
  tail beyond B. This is what lets a stop ride *through* a hub to the far side.

For every candidate we also record the nodes its path passes **through** (within
`node_on_route_buffer_ft`) — those are the transfer points a rider on the route can
reach, and the travel-time objective in the next step picks the best one per stop.

```{r candidates}
join_vseq <- function(vseq_a, vseq_b) c(rev(vseq_a), vseq_b[-1])

# Planar node points, for "which nodes does this path pass through" detection.
node_pts_planar <- sf::st_geometry(
  sf::st_transform(
    sf::st_as_sf(node_info[, c("lon", "lat")], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326),
    params$planar_crs))
nodes_on_route <- function(coords) {
  if (is.null(coords) || nrow(coords) < 2) return(integer(0))
  line <- sf::st_linestring(coords) |> sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326) |>
    sf::st_transform(params$planar_crs)
  which(as.numeric(sf::st_distance(node_pts_planar, line)) <= params$node_on_route_buffer_ft)
}

candidates <- list()
add_cand <- function(type, vseq, design_nodes) {
  coords <- path_to_coords(vseq)
  if (is.null(coords) || nrow(coords) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))
  candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <<- list(
    type = type, vseq = vseq, coords = coords,
    covered = covered_by_path(coords),
    nodes   = sort(union(design_nodes, nodes_on_route(coords)))   # always incl. design nodes
  )
}

# --- Single-node: paired through-routes + leftover spokes ---
for (ni in seq_len(n_nodes)) {
  idx <- which(vapply(spokes, `[[`, integer(1), "node_idx") == ni)
  if (length(idx) == 0L) next
  paired <- rep(FALSE, length(idx))
  for (a in seq_along(idx)) {
    if (paired[a]) next
    best_b <- NA_integer_; best_diff <- Inf
    for (b in seq_along(idx)) {
      if (b == a || paired[b]) next
      d <- abs(((spokes[[idx[a]]]$bearing - spokes[[idx[b]]]$bearing) %% 360) - 180)
      if (d < best_diff) { best_diff <- d; best_b <- b }
    }
    if (!is.na(best_b) && best_diff <= params$pair_bearing_tol) {
      paired[a] <- TRUE; paired[best_b] <- TRUE
      add_cand("through", join_vseq(spokes[[idx[a]]]$vseq, spokes[[idx[best_b]]]$vseq), ni)
    } else {
      paired[a] <- TRUE
      add_cand("spoke", spokes[[idx[a]]]$vseq, ni)
    }
  }
}

# --- Multi-node through-lines: tail(A, away from B) + path(A→B) + tail(B, away from A) ---
cat("Building multi-node through-lines (1 batched dodgr call)...\n")
nn_paths <- dodgr::dodgr_paths(graph, from = node_vert, to = node_vert, vertices = TRUE)

# best spoke at node `nd` whose bearing is within tol of `want` (the outward dir)
outward_spoke <- function(nd, want) {
  idx <- which(vapply(spokes, `[[`, integer(1), "node_idx") == nd)
  if (length(idx) == 0L) return(NULL)
  d <- vapply(idx, function(k)
    abs(((spokes[[k]]$bearing - want) %% 360 + 180) %% 360 - 180), numeric(1))
  if (min(d) > params$pair_bearing_tol) return(NULL)
  spokes[[idx[which.min(d)]]]
}

for (a in seq_len(n_nodes - 1)) {
  for (b in (a + 1):n_nodes) {
    spine <- nn_paths[[a]][[b]]
    if (is.null(spine) || length(spine) < 2L) next
    bear_ab <- bearing_deg(node_info$lon[a], node_info$lat[a],
                           node_info$lon[b], node_info$lat[b])
    ta <- outward_spoke(a, (bear_ab + 180) %% 360)   # tail at A points away from B
    tb <- outward_spoke(b, bear_ab)                  # tail at B points away from A
    vseq <- spine
    if (!is.null(ta)) vseq <- c(rev(ta$vseq), vseq[-1])
    if (!is.null(tb)) vseq <- c(vseq, tb$vseq[-1])
    add_cand("line", vseq, c(a, b))
  }
}

cat(sprintf("Candidate local routes: %d\n", length(candidates)))
print(table(type = vapply(candidates, `[[`, character(1), "type")))
print(table(nodes_passed = vapply(candidates, function(c) length(c$nodes), integer(1))))
```

### Route cost — best access to each node + onward time

Two precomputed pieces feed the optimizer:

- `a_sn[s, n]` — the **best along-route ride time** from stop `s` to node `n`,
  over every candidate that covers `s` and passes through `n`. If the network
  selects any such route, the stop can reach `n` in about this time.
- `p(s, d)` — stop `s`'s destination distribution, from its home area's outbound
  demand. Express leg `S(n, d)` (+ a transfer unless `n == d`) is the express design.

The optimizer then lets each stop's trip to `d` use the best node it can reach
**across all selected routes that serve it** — so a boundary stop reached by two
routes (or one through-line) can ride each direction the way that's fastest.

```{r route-cost}
S <- cd$service_time_matrix
S[!is.finite(S)] <- max(S[is.finite(S)], na.rm = TRUE)   # cap unreachable express pairs
D <- cd$demand_matrix

bus_speed_fpm  <- params$bus_speed_mph * 5280 / 60
transfer_pen   <- params$express_transfer_min
access_cap_min <- 30        # ignore stop→node access slower than this (never the best option)

line_planar <- function(coords) {
  m <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_transform(
    sf::st_sfc(sf::st_linestring(coords), crs = 4326), params$planar_crs))
  m[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
}
# arc-length (planar ft) of each point projected onto a polyline
project_along <- function(pts_xy, line_xy) {
  if (nrow(line_xy) < 2) return(rep(0, nrow(pts_xy)))
  s0 <- line_xy[-nrow(line_xy), , drop = FALSE]; s1 <- line_xy[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  sv <- s1 - s0; sl2 <- rowSums(sv^2); seglen <- sqrt(sl2); cum <- c(0, cumsum(seglen))
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(pts_xy)), function(p) {
    px <- pts_xy[p, 1]; py <- pts_xy[p, 2]
    t <- ((px - s0[, 1]) * sv[, 1] + (py - s0[, 2]) * sv[, 2]) / pmax(sl2, 1e-9)
    t <- pmin(pmax(t, 0), 1)
    k <- which.min((s0[, 1] + t * sv[, 1] - px)^2 + (s0[, 2] + t * sv[, 2] - py)^2)
    cum[k] + t[k] * seglen[k]
  }, numeric(1))
}
# perpendicular distance (planar ft) of each point to a polyline (mirrors project_along)
dist_to_line <- function(pts_xy, line_xy) {
  if (nrow(line_xy) < 2) return(rep(Inf, nrow(pts_xy)))
  s0 <- line_xy[-nrow(line_xy), , drop = FALSE]; s1 <- line_xy[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  sv <- s1 - s0; sl2 <- rowSums(sv^2)
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(pts_xy)), function(p) {
    px <- pts_xy[p, 1]; py <- pts_xy[p, 2]
    t <- ((px - s0[, 1]) * sv[, 1] + (py - s0[, 2]) * sv[, 2]) / pmax(sl2, 1e-9)
    t <- pmin(pmax(t, 0), 1)
    sqrt(min((s0[, 1] + t * sv[, 1] - px)^2 + (s0[, 2] + t * sv[, 2] - py)^2))
  }, numeric(1))
}

stops_planar_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(stops_sf)            # X,Y planar
node_planar_xy  <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_transform(
  sf::st_as_sf(node_info[, c("lon", "lat")], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326),
  params$planar_crs))

home_node <- max.col(-t(T_node_stop), ties.method = "first")
Drow <- D[home_node, , drop = FALSE]
rs <- rowSums(Drow); rs[rs == 0] <- 1
P <- Drow / rs                                             # n_stops × n_nodes destination dist

# Best access a_sn[s,n] (min ride over covering routes that pass n) + the
# (stop, node, route) incidence used to link "stop reaches n" to route selection.
# Also cand_onroute[[r]] = covered stops within on_route_buffer_ft of route r
# (the route's PHYSICAL bus stops) — used for fleet weighting and export.
a_sn <- matrix(Inf, n_stops, n_nodes)
inc_list <- vector("list", 0)
cand_onroute <- vector("list", length(candidates))
on_route_ft  <- params$on_route_buffer_ft
for (r in seq_along(candidates)) {
  cand_onroute[[r]] <- integer(0)
  cov <- candidates[[r]]$covered; Nr <- candidates[[r]]$nodes
  if (length(cov) == 0L) next
  lxy   <- line_planar(candidates[[r]]$coords)
  cand_onroute[[r]] <- cov[dist_to_line(stops_planar_xy[cov, , drop = FALSE], lxy) <= on_route_ft]
  arc_s <- project_along(stops_planar_xy[cov, , drop = FALSE], lxy)
  arc_n <- project_along(node_planar_xy[Nr, , drop = FALSE], lxy)
  for (m in seq_along(Nr)) {
    ride <- abs(arc_s - arc_n[m]) / bus_speed_fpm
    a_sn[cbind(cov, Nr[m])] <- pmin(a_sn[cbind(cov, Nr[m])], ride)
    inc_list[[length(inc_list) + 1]] <- cbind(s = cov, n = Nr[m], r = r)
  }
}
inc <- do.call(rbind, inc_list)
a_sn[a_sn > access_cap_min] <- Inf                        # prune far (never-best) access
cat(sprintf("Reachable (stop,node) pairs: %d | incidence rows: %d | mean on-route stops/cand: %.1f\n",
            sum(is.finite(a_sn)), nrow(inc), mean(lengths(cand_onroute))))
```

### Travel-time ILP — reach all nearby nodes

Choose routes `x`. A stop **reaches** node `n` if any selected route covering it
passes `n` (`reach[s,n] ≤ Σ x` over those routes). Each stop→destination trip
then uses the **best node it can reach** (`y[s,d,n]`) — across *all* its selected
routes, riding direct when one reaches the destination's own node. Objective:
minimize demand-weighted trip time `+ lambda_fleet × buses`, with optional local
trips earning `local_served_reward`. Because reaching a second node cuts a
boundary stop's trip time, the optimizer pays for the through-line (or second
route) that delivers it — this is what closes the boundary gaps. Only the route
on/off `x` are integer; `reach` and `y` come out integral on their own.

```{r select-ilp}
for (p in c("highs", "Matrix"))
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(highs); library(Matrix) })

is_freq  <- stops_sf$kind == "frequent"
cov_sets <- lapply(candidates, `[[`, "covered")
N_cand   <- length(candidates)
gamma    <- params$local_served_reward

# Per-candidate peak bus requirement (matches the fleet diagnostic). Dwell is
# charged only at ON-ROUTE stops (+ nodes) — walkshed-only stops aren't bus stops,
# so they add no dwell. This keeps the selection's fleet weight consistent with
# the GTFS the diagnostic measures (was overcounting dwell at all covered stops).
cand_lines  <- sf::st_sfc(lapply(candidates, function(c) sf::st_linestring(c$coords)), crs = 4326)
cand_len_ft <- as.numeric(sf::st_length(sf::st_transform(cand_lines, params$planar_crs)))
n_stops_cand <- vapply(seq_len(N_cand), function(r)
  length(cand_onroute[[r]]) + length(candidates[[r]]$nodes), integer(1))

# Per-candidate one-way time from the SHARED street-derived model (same speeds + dwell as the GTFS
# output), so route selection trades fleet on real running times — not a flat 30 mph / 20 s.
sel_p <- gst_default_params(list(
  crs_work = params$planar_crs, stop_route_buffer_ft = 700,
  signals_gpkg = "data/public/sdot/traffic_signals.gpkg",
  alllanes_geojson = "outputs/streets/street_grid.geojson"))
sel_routes <- sf::st_sf(rid = sprintf("C%04d", seq_len(N_cand)), geometry = cand_lines)
sel_stops  <- rbind(
  sf::st_sf(stop_id  = stops_sf$stop_uid,
            geometry = sf::st_transform(sf::st_geometry(stops_sf), params$planar_crs)),
  sf::st_sf(stop_id  = sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id),
            geometry = sf::st_geometry(sf::st_transform(
              sf::st_as_sf(node_info[, c("lon","lat")], coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326),
              params$planar_crs))))
cat(sprintf("Candidate timing via shared model: %d candidates\n", N_cand))
sel_refs    <- gst_load_refs(sel_p)
sel_prepped <- gst_prep(sel_routes, sel_refs, sel_p)
sel_stops   <- gst_classify_stops(sel_stops, sel_prepped, sel_refs, sel_p)
one_way_min <- vapply(seq_len(N_cand), function(r) {
  rsids <- unique(c(stops_sf$stop_uid[cand_onroute[[r]]],
                    sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id[candidates[[r]]$nodes])))
  res <- gst_route_stop_times(sprintf("C%04d", r), sel_routes[r, ],
                              sel_stops[sel_stops$stop_id %in% rsids, ], sel_prepped, sel_p)
  if (is.null(res)) cand_len_ft[r] / bus_speed_fpm + n_stops_cand[r] * params$local_dwell_sec / 60
  else res$runtime_s / 60
}, numeric(1))
buses_cand  <- pmax(1L, as.integer(ceiling(2 * one_way_min / params$local_day_headway_min)))

# --- reach[s,n] vars: one per reachable (stop,node) pair ---
rp <- which(is.finite(a_sn), arr.ind = TRUE)
rp_s <- rp[, 1]; rp_n <- rp[, 2]; n_rn <- length(rp_s)
reach_id <- matrix(0L, n_stops, n_nodes); reach_id[cbind(rp_s, rp_n)] <- seq_len(n_rn)

# --- y[s,d,n] vars: reachable (s,n) × each destination d the stop has demand to ---
Dlist  <- lapply(seq_len(n_stops), function(s) which(P[s, ] > 0))
nd_per <- lengths(Dlist[rp_s])
n_y    <- sum(nd_per)
y_k    <- rep(seq_len(n_rn), nd_per)                 # reach-pair index per y
y_s    <- rp_s[y_k]; y_n <- rp_n[y_k]
y_d    <- unlist(Dlist[rp_s])
c_y    <- a_sn[cbind(y_s, y_n)] + S[cbind(y_n, y_d)] + ifelse(y_n == y_d, 0, transfer_pen)
p_y    <- P[cbind(y_s, y_d)]
obj_y  <- p_y * (c_y - ifelse(is_freq[y_s], 0, gamma))

nv <- N_cand + n_rn + n_y
ix_reach <- N_cand + seq_len(n_rn)
ix_y     <- N_cand + n_rn + seq_len(n_y)

# Block 0: frequent coverage  Σ_n reach[s,n] ≥ 1
fr_row <- integer(n_stops)
fr_stops <- which(is_freq & (tabulate(rp_s, n_stops) > 0)); n_fr <- length(fr_stops)
fr_row[fr_stops] <- seq_len(n_fr)
sel0 <- fr_row[rp_s] > 0
b0_i <- fr_row[rp_s][sel0]; b0_j <- ix_reach[which(sel0)]; b0_x <- rep(1, sum(sel0))

# Block 1: reach[k] − Σ_{r covers s & passes n} x_r ≤ 0
inc_k <- reach_id[cbind(inc[, "s"], inc[, "n"])]; keep <- inc_k > 0
b1_i <- n_fr + c(seq_len(n_rn), inc_k[keep])
b1_j <- c(ix_reach,             inc[keep, "r"])
b1_x <- c(rep(1, n_rn),         rep(-1, sum(keep)))

# Block 2: y[j] − reach[k(j)] ≤ 0
b2_i <- n_fr + n_rn + rep(seq_len(n_y), 2)
b2_j <- c(ix_y, ix_reach[y_k])
b2_x <- c(rep(1, n_y), rep(-1, n_y))

# Block 3: assignment Σ_n y[s,d,n]  (=1 frequent, ≤1 local), per (s,d)
sd_key <- y_s * 100L + y_d
sd_grp <- match(sd_key, unique(sd_key)); n_sd <- max(sd_grp)
b3_i <- n_fr + n_rn + n_y + sd_grp; b3_j <- ix_y; b3_x <- rep(1, n_y)
ug <- !duplicated(sd_grp); grp_stop <- integer(n_sd); grp_stop[sd_grp[ug]] <- y_s[ug]
grp_lhs <- ifelse(is_freq[grp_stop], 1, -Inf); grp_rhs <- rep(1, n_sd)

A <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = c(b0_i, b1_i, b2_i, b3_i),
  j = c(b0_j, b1_j, b2_j, b3_j),
  x = c(b0_x, b1_x, b2_x, b3_x),
  dims = c(n_fr + n_rn + n_y + n_sd, nv))
lhs   <- c(rep(1, n_fr),   rep(-Inf, n_rn), rep(-Inf, n_y), grp_lhs)
rhs   <- c(rep(Inf, n_fr), rep(0,    n_rn), rep(0,    n_y), grp_rhs)
obj   <- c(params$lambda_fleet * buses_cand, rep(0, n_rn), obj_y)
types <- c(rep("I", N_cand), rep("C", n_rn + n_y))

cat(sprintf("Reach-ILP: %d routes, %d reach, %d trips (%d vars, %d constraints). Solving (HiGHS)...\n",
            N_cand, n_rn, n_y, nv, nrow(A)))
t0  <- Sys.time()
res <- highs::highs_solve(L = obj, lower = rep(0, nv), upper = rep(1, nv),
                          A = A, lhs = lhs, rhs = rhs, types = types, maximum = FALSE,
                          control = highs::highs_control(mip_rel_gap = 0.02, time_limit = 600))
cat(sprintf("HiGHS: %s in %.1f s\n", res$status_message,
            as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")))

xv <- res$primal_solution[seq_len(N_cand)]
yv <- res$primal_solution[ix_y]
selected <- which(xv > 0.5)
covered  <- logical(n_stops); for (ci in selected) covered[cov_sets[[ci]]] <- TRUE

served <- yv > 0.5
sf_ <- served & is_freq[y_s]
freq_cov_n <- sum(covered[is_freq]); n_uncov_freq <- sum(is_freq) - freq_cov_n
cat(sprintf("Selected %d routes | fleet ≈ %d buses @ %g-min | total rider-time %.0f min\n",
            length(selected), sum(buses_cand[selected]), params$local_day_headway_min,
            sum(p_y[served] * c_y[served])))
cat(sprintf("Mean frequent trip time (ride to node + onward): %.1f min\n",
            if (any(sf_)) sum(p_y[sf_] * c_y[sf_]) / sum(p_y[sf_]) else NA_real_))
cat(sprintf("Frequent covered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)%s\n",
            freq_cov_n, sum(is_freq), 100 * freq_cov_n / sum(is_freq),
            if (n_uncov_freq > 0) sprintf("  [%d uncoverable]", n_uncov_freq) else ""))
cat(sprintf("Local covered:    %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(covered[!is_freq]), sum(!is_freq), 100 * mean(covered[!is_freq])))
cat("Selected route types:\n"); print(table(type = vapply(candidates[selected], `[[`, character(1), "type")))
cat("Nodes passed-through per selected route:\n")
print(table(nodes = vapply(candidates[selected], function(c) length(c$nodes), integer(1))))
```

### On-route bus stops vs. walkshed coverage

`covered` (used for *selection*) is walkshed: a stop is served if a route passes
within `walk_dist_ft`. But the bus only physically **stops** where a stop lies on
its path. Here we split each route's covered stops into **on-route** (within
`on_route_buffer_ft` — real bus stops, get dwell, go in the GTFS/shapefile) and
**walkshed-only** (farther out — the rider walks to the route; the bus does *not*
stop, so no dwell). `route_onroute[[r]]` and `on_route_any` drive the export.

```{r on-route-stops}
# route_onroute is exactly cand_onroute (computed once for all candidates in the
# route-cost chunk, so the fleet weight and the export use the identical stop set).
route_onroute <- cand_onroute
n_board <- integer(n_stops)                              # # selected routes boarding each stop
for (r in selected) n_board[route_onroute[[r]]] <- n_board[route_onroute[[r]]] + 1L
on_route_any <- n_board > 0L

# Distance to nearest selected route, for the on-route/walkshed banding report.
min_d_sel <- rep(Inf, n_stops)
for (r in selected) {
  cov <- candidates[[r]]$covered
  if (!length(cov)) next
  d <- dist_to_line(stops_planar_xy[cov, , drop = FALSE], line_planar(candidates[[r]]$coords))
  min_d_sel[cov] <- pmin(min_d_sel[cov], d)
}

band <- cut(min_d_sel[is.finite(min_d_sel)],
            breaks = c(-1, on_route_ft, params$walk_dist_ft, Inf),
            labels = c(sprintf("on-route (<=%gft)", on_route_ft),
                       sprintf("walkshed (%g-%gft)", on_route_ft, params$walk_dist_ft),
                       "beyond"))
cat("Covered stops by distance to nearest selected route:\n"); print(table(band))
cat(sprintf("Frequent: %d board a bus on-route, %d walkshed-only (rider walks to route)\n",
            sum(on_route_any & is_freq), sum(covered & is_freq & !on_route_any)))
cat(sprintf("Local:    %d board a bus on-route, %d walkshed-only\n",
            sum(on_route_any & !is_freq), sum(covered & !is_freq & !on_route_any)))
n_thin <- sum(vapply(selected, function(r) length(route_onroute[[r]]) == 0L, logical(1)))
if (n_thin > 0) cat(sprintf("NOTE: %d selected route(s) have 0 on-route stops (served only via walkshed).\n", n_thin))
```

### Save

```{r local-save}
local_routes <- lapply(seq_along(selected), function(s) {
  ci <- candidates[[selected[s]]]
  list(local_id = s, type = ci$type, nodes = ci$nodes,
       vseq = ci$vseq, coords = ci$coords, covered = ci$covered)
})

saveRDS(
  list(routes = local_routes,
       stops  = stops_sf,
       covered = covered,
       is_freq = is_freq,
       params  = params),
  file.path(params$out_dir, "local_routes.rds")
)

# Uncovered frequent stops (the "couldn't serve" list for the writeup)
unc_freq <- stops_sf[is_freq & !covered, ]
cat(sprintf("Uncovered frequent stops: %d\n", nrow(unc_freq)))
if (nrow(unc_freq) > 0) print(st_drop_geometry(unc_freq))
```

## Export: GTFS feed + shapefiles for ArcGIS

The local feed is **self-contained** but uses the same node stop IDs (`N###`)
as the express feed, so a rider's transfer at a node is recognized as the same
physical stop across both feeds. Schedule conventions mirror the express feed
(frequencies-based, Mon–Fri), but with local headways and a slower cruise speed.

Each local route stops at the actual served stops (within `walk_dist_ft` of its
path) plus the node(s) it runs through, ordered by position along the route
polyline. Inter-stop travel time = along-path distance ÷ `bus_speed_mph`, with
`dwell_sec` at each stop.

```{r local-export-params}
gtfs_dir   <- file.path(params$out_dir, "gtfs_node_local")
gtfs_zip   <- file.path(params$gtfs_out_dir, "gtfs_node_local.zip")
shp_routes <- file.path(params$out_dir, "local_routes.shp")
shp_stops  <- file.path(params$out_dir, "local_stops.shp")
dir.create(gtfs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dwell_sec          <- as.integer(params$local_dwell_sec)
bus_speed_fpm      <- params$bus_speed_mph * 5280 / 60     # feet per minute
day_start          <- "05:00:00"; day_end   <- "22:00:00"
night_start        <- "22:00:00"; night_end <- "29:00:00"  # 1 AM next service day
day_headway_sec    <- as.integer(params$local_day_headway_min   * 60)
night_headway_sec  <- as.integer(params$local_night_headway_min * 60)
service_start_date <- "20260101"; service_end_date <- "20261231"

# Arc-length position (planar feet) of each point projected onto a polyline.
# line_xy: Nx2 planar; pts_xy: Mx2 planar. Clamps to segment ends so points
# off the line still get a sensible along-line position for ordering.
project_along <- function(pts_xy, line_xy) {
  if (nrow(line_xy) < 2) return(rep(0, nrow(pts_xy)))
  s0 <- line_xy[-nrow(line_xy), , drop = FALSE]
  s1 <- line_xy[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  sv  <- s1 - s0
  sl2 <- rowSums(sv^2)
  seglen <- sqrt(sl2)
  cum <- c(0, cumsum(seglen))
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(pts_xy)), function(p) {
    px <- pts_xy[p, 1]; py <- pts_xy[p, 2]
    t  <- ((px - s0[, 1]) * sv[, 1] + (py - s0[, 2]) * sv[, 2]) / pmax(sl2, 1e-9)
    t  <- pmin(pmax(t, 0), 1)
    dx <- s0[, 1] + t * sv[, 1] - px
    dy <- s0[, 2] + t * sv[, 2] - py
    k  <- which.min(dx^2 + dy^2)
    cum[k] + t[k] * seglen[k]
  }, numeric(1))
}

# Planar coords for stops and nodes (project once, reuse per route).
stops_planar_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(stops_sf)            # X,Y in planar_crs
node_planar_xy  <- sf::st_coordinates(
  sf::st_transform(
    sf::st_as_sf(node_info[, c("lon", "lat")], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326),
    params$planar_crs))

# lon/lat route polyline -> Nx2 planar matrix
line_planar <- function(coords_lonlat) {
  m <- sf::st_linestring(coords_lonlat) |>
    sf::st_sfc(crs = 4326) |>
    sf::st_transform(params$planar_crs) |>
    sf::st_coordinates()
  m[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
}
```

### Build GTFS tables

```{r local-build-gtfs}
n_routes <- length(selected)
cat(sprintf("Generating local GTFS for %d routes\n", n_routes))

agency_df <- data.frame(
  agency_id = "NodeNetLocal", agency_name = "Node-Based Network — Local",
  agency_url = "https://example.org/node-net",
  agency_timezone = "America/Los_Angeles", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

calendar_df <- data.frame(
  service_id = "WEEKDAY",
  monday = 1L, tuesday = 1L, wednesday = 1L, thursday = 1L, friday = 1L,
  saturday = 0L, sunday = 0L,
  start_date = service_start_date, end_date = service_end_date,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- stops.txt: on-route bus stops + every node. Nodes reuse the express feed's
#     N### ids so a node is one physical stop across both feeds. (Walkshed-only
#     covered stops are not bus stops, so they are not listed.) ---
served_idx <- which(on_route_any)
stops_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    stop_id   = stops_sf$stop_uid[served_idx],
    stop_name = sprintf("%s %s", stops_sf$kind[served_idx], stops_sf$stop_uid[served_idx]),
    stop_lat  = round(stops_xy[served_idx, "y"], 7),
    stop_lon  = round(stops_xy[served_idx, "x"], 7),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(
    stop_id   = sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id),
    stop_name = sprintf("Node cell %d", node_info$cell_id),
    stop_lat  = round(node_info$lat, 7),
    stop_lon  = round(node_info$lon, 7),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
stops_df <- stops_df[!duplicated(stops_df$stop_id), ]

# routes.txt
route_label <- function(ci) {
  cc <- candidates[[ci]]; nl <- node_info$cell_id[cc$nodes]
  switch(cc$type,
    spoke   = sprintf("Local to Node %d",     nl[1]),
    through = sprintf("Local through Node %d", nl[1]),
    line    = sprintf("Local %s", paste(nl, collapse = " ↔ ")),
    "Local")
}
routes_df <- data.frame(
  route_id         = sprintf("LOC%03d", seq_len(n_routes)),
  agency_id        = "NodeNetLocal",
  route_short_name = sprintf("L%03d", seq_len(n_routes)),
  route_long_name  = vapply(selected, route_label, character(1)),
  route_type       = 3L, route_color = "8B4513", route_text_color = "FFFFFF",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

trips_list <- list(); stop_times_list <- list()
shapes_list <- list(); freq_list <- list()

# ---- shared street-derived stop-time model (identical to the grid network) ----
# Build sf routes/stops, run the grid pipeline (20/30 mph speed floors + accel/decel + signal /
# gap-acceptance dwell + through-intersection delay), then read stop_times per route. Replaces the
# old flat `bus_speed_mph` + `dwell_sec`. Local feeders have no bus lane, so the re-entry gate keeps
# their non-signalized dwell at the base (≈8 s) — slower mid-block on residential, much less dwell.
gst_p <- gst_default_params(list(
  crs_work             = params$planar_crs,
  stop_route_buffer_ft = 700,   # generous: keep every ILP-assigned stop/node on the route
  signals_gpkg         = "data/public/sdot/traffic_signals.gpkg",
  alllanes_geojson     = "outputs/streets/street_grid.geojson"))
gst_routes <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_routes), function(r) {
  co <- candidates[[selected[r]]]$coords
  if (is.null(co) || nrow(co) < 2) return(NULL)
  sf::st_sf(rid = sprintf("LOC%03d", r),
            geometry = sf::st_sfc(sf::st_linestring(co[, 1:2]), crs = 4326))
}))
gst_stops   <- sf::st_as_sf(stops_df, coords = c("stop_lon", "stop_lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
gst_refs    <- gst_load_refs(gst_p)
gst_prepped <- gst_prep(gst_routes, gst_refs, gst_p)
gst_stops   <- gst_classify_stops(gst_stops, gst_prepped, gst_refs, gst_p)
cat(sprintf("stop-time model: %d routes, %d stops, %.0f%% signalized\n",
            nrow(gst_routes), nrow(gst_stops), 100 * mean(gst_stops$signalized)))

for (r in seq_len(n_routes)) {
  ci       <- candidates[[selected[r]]]
  route_id <- sprintf("LOC%03d", r)
  shape_id <- sprintf("SLOC%03d", r)
  coords   <- ci$coords
  if (is.null(coords) || nrow(coords) < 2L) next

  # shape (forward geometry; both directions share it)
  shapes_list[[length(shapes_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    shape_id          = shape_id,
    shape_pt_lat      = round(coords[, 2], 7),
    shape_pt_lon      = round(coords[, 1], 7),
    shape_pt_sequence = seq_len(nrow(coords)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # this route's stops: ON-ROUTE stops + designated node(s), timed by the shared grid model
  sidx  <- route_onroute[[selected[r]]]; if (is.null(sidx)) sidx <- integer(0)
  rsids <- unique(c(stops_sf$stop_uid[sidx], sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id[ci$nodes])))
  cand  <- gst_stops[gst_stops$stop_id %in% rsids, ]
  res   <- gst_route_stop_times(route_id, gst_routes[gst_routes$rid == route_id, ], cand, gst_prepped, gst_p)
  if (is.null(res)) next
  stop_times_list[[length(stop_times_list) + 1]] <- res$st0
  stop_times_list[[length(stop_times_list) + 1]] <- res$st1

  for (dir in 0:1) {
    trip_id <- sprintf("%s_d%d", route_id, dir)
    trips_list[[length(trips_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      route_id = route_id, service_id = "WEEKDAY", trip_id = trip_id,
      shape_id = shape_id, direction_id = as.integer(dir), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    freq_list[[length(freq_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      trip_id = trip_id, start_time = c(day_start, night_start),
      end_time = c(day_end, night_end),
      headway_secs = c(day_headway_sec, night_headway_sec),
      exact_times = 0L, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}

trips_df      <- bind_rows(trips_list)
stop_times_df <- bind_rows(stop_times_list)
shapes_df     <- bind_rows(shapes_list)
freq_df       <- bind_rows(freq_list)

# Referential integrity: keep only stops that a trip actually visits.
stops_df <- stops_df[stops_df$stop_id %in% unique(stop_times_df$stop_id), ]

data.frame(
  table = c("agency", "routes", "stops", "trips", "stop_times",
            "shapes", "calendar", "frequencies"),
  rows  = c(nrow(agency_df), nrow(routes_df), nrow(stops_df),
            nrow(trips_df), nrow(stop_times_df), nrow(shapes_df),
            nrow(calendar_df), nrow(freq_df)))
```

### Write GTFS feed + zip

```{r local-write-gtfs}
fwrite(agency_df,     file.path(gtfs_dir, "agency.txt"))
fwrite(routes_df,     file.path(gtfs_dir, "routes.txt"))
fwrite(stops_df,      file.path(gtfs_dir, "stops.txt"))
fwrite(trips_df,      file.path(gtfs_dir, "trips.txt"))
fwrite(stop_times_df, file.path(gtfs_dir, "stop_times.txt"))
fwrite(calendar_df,   file.path(gtfs_dir, "calendar.txt"))
fwrite(shapes_df,     file.path(gtfs_dir, "shapes.txt"))
fwrite(freq_df,       file.path(gtfs_dir, "frequencies.txt"))

if (file.exists(gtfs_zip)) unlink(gtfs_zip)
# Pure-R zip (the external `zip` program isn't on PATH on Windows, so
# utils::zip() silently produced no archive). setwd into the feed dir +
# relative file names makes the .txt files sit at the archive root (GTFS
# requires a flat archive); zip::zip's `root=` arg did NOT flatten here.
gtfs_zip_abs <- file.path(normalizePath(dirname(gtfs_zip)), basename(gtfs_zip))
old_wd <- setwd(gtfs_dir)
tryCatch(zip::zip(zipfile = gtfs_zip_abs, files = list.files(".")),
         finally = setwd(old_wd))
cat(sprintf("GTFS feed: %s\n", normalizePath(gtfs_zip)))
```

### Write shapefiles (routes + stops) for ArcGIS

```{r local-write-shapefiles}
route_rows <- lapply(seq_len(n_routes), function(r) {
  ci     <- candidates[[selected[r]]]
  coords <- ci$coords
  if (is.null(coords) || nrow(coords) < 2L) return(NULL)
  lxy    <- line_planar(coords)
  len_mi <- sum(sqrt(rowSums(diff(lxy)^2))) / 5280
  cov    <- route_onroute[[selected[r]]]; if (is.null(cov)) cov <- integer(0)  # physical stops
  list(local_id = r, type = ci$type,
       nodes  = paste(node_info$cell_id[ci$nodes], collapse = "-"),
       n_stop = length(cov), n_freq = sum(is_freq[cov]),
       len_mi = round(len_mi, 2), geom = sf::st_linestring(coords))
})
route_rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), route_rows)

routes_shp <- sf::st_sf(
  local_id = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, integer(1),   "local_id"),
  type     = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, character(1), "type"),
  nodes    = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, character(1), "nodes"),
  n_stop   = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, integer(1),   "n_stop"),
  n_freq   = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, integer(1),   "n_freq"),
  len_mi   = vapply(route_rows, `[[`, numeric(1),   "len_mi"),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(lapply(route_rows, `[[`, "geom"), crs = 4326))

# Stops: only the ACTUAL bus stops (on-route, where the bus dwells) + nodes.
# Walkshed-only covered stops are excluded — the bus does not stop there.
board_idx <- which(on_route_any)
served_shp <- sf::st_transform(stops_sf[board_idx, ], 4326)
served_shp$n_routes <- n_board[board_idx]            # # selected routes boarding this stop
served_shp <- served_shp[, c("stop_uid", "kind", "n_routes")]
node_shp <- sf::st_as_sf(
  data.frame(stop_uid = sprintf("N%03d", node_info$cell_id), kind = "node",
             n_routes = NA_integer_, lon = node_info$lon, lat = node_info$lat,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
sf::st_geometry(served_shp) <- "geometry"
sf::st_geometry(node_shp)   <- "geometry"
stops_shp <- rbind(served_shp, node_shp[, c("stop_uid", "kind", "n_routes")])
cat(sprintf("local_stops.shp: %d on-route bus stops + %d nodes\n",
            length(board_idx), nrow(node_shp)))

# Clean old shapefile siblings before writing
for (base in c(tools::file_path_sans_ext(shp_routes),
               tools::file_path_sans_ext(shp_stops))) {
  for (ext in c(".shp", ".shx", ".dbf", ".prj", ".cpg")) {
    f <- paste0(base, ext); if (file.exists(f)) unlink(f)
  }
}
st_write(routes_shp, shp_routes, append = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
st_write(stops_shp,  shp_stops,  append = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Shapefiles:\n  %s\n  %s\n",
            normalizePath(shp_routes), normalizePath(shp_stops)))
```
